resources.string: Keeps the Home button with Kara\'s TV (bounces Google TV\'s stock launcher), runs your remote-button remapping in every app, and shows floating camera windows over movies. Kara\'s TV does not read or collect what is on screen.
Home guard, button remapper and floating cameras
Open Kara\'s TV automatically when the TV powers on.
The guard needs the accessibility service switched on in system Settings. Tap below, find Kara\'s TV in the list, and turn it on.
Home guard service is OFF — open accessibility settings to enable it

Give any button a different job for a single, long or double press — overriding the stock Google TV behaviour in every app. Works for every button that reaches the accessibility service (use Learn a button to check one). Mappings pause inside Kara\'s TV\'s own screens, so you can always undo them. OK and the D-pad are never remapped.

As device owner, Kara\'s TV pins itself as the persistent HOME handler and can hide the stock launcher packages. This usually only works before a Google account is added during setup — after setup, dpm set-device-owner fails.
Another launcher (usually Google TV’s) took over the Home button. Tap below to make Kara\'s TV the default again.
Tap to make Kara\'s TV the default again
Name for this input, e.g. PS5
